title: Bacterial analysis in fruit juice effluent from Dark and Photofermentation reactors
description: Near full-length 16S rRNA gene sequencing dataset from microbial communities in a continuous dark fermentation-photofermentation system treating fruit-processing wastewater for hydrogen production. Samples were obtained from dark fermentation and photofermentation reactor effluents operated at 10 or 7 h hydraulic retention time under 45/15, 30/30, or 15/45 min light/dark cycles. Sequencing targeted the V1-V9 regions of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene using Oxford Nanopore MinION sequencing. The dataset was generated to evaluate changes in bacterial community composition associated with hydraulic retention time and intermittent illumination.
